bias.en: Downtrend · broke $577, lowest close since August
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $577，收盘创 8月以来新低

read.en: Meta fell 5.9% on Nov 20 to $560.84, its lowest close since Aug 24, trading $558.68–588.69. It is below the 5-day ($603.7), 10-day ($619.6), 30-day ($648.3) and 200-day ($628.6), all falling, and the rising 100-day ($638.8). MACD crossed back below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 19 ($647.40), and RSI is 30.3, down from 47.8 five sessions ago.
read.zh: Meta 11月20日下跌 5.9%，收于 $560.84，为 8月24日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $558.68–588.69。股价位于 5 日（$603.7）、10 日（$619.6）、30 日（$648.3）和 200 日均线（$628.6）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 100 日均线（$638.8）。MACD 于 11月20日重新下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月19日起看空（$647.40），RSI 为 30.3，五个交易日前为 47.8。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $577–596 (Nov 19, Nov 5 and Jul 9 lows), now resistance. Resistance is $574.7–577, then $583.8–588.7 (Nov 5 low, Nov 20 high) and $596–604 (Nov 19 low, 5-day). Support is $556–558.7 (Nov 20, Jun 11 and Sep 1 lows), then $537–540 (August and June lows) and $520–524.5 (52-week low). A close above $577 would target $583.8–588.7; below $556, $537–540.

r.en: Nov 5 low $583.80, lost; Mar 20 low $587.25; Nov 20 high $588.69
